#  **API Planning Documentation**

## **Pickup & Delivery Scheduler**

**![https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize%3Afit%3A1400/1%2ArxeaKKsO6f5s\_-ayOskf8A.png][image1]**

---

## **1\. API Overview**

The Pickup & Delivery Scheduler system exposes **REST-based APIs** for:

* Order management

* Delivery agent management

* System monitoring and administration

APIs are **grouped by service responsibility**.  
 Internal **service-to-service communication** is handled asynchronously using **events**.

## **2\. Order Service APIs**

### **2.1 Create Pickup / Delivery Order**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `/api/orders` |
| Description | Create a new pickup or delivery request |

**Request Body**

| Parameter | Type | Required |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| pickup\_location | string | Yes |
| delivery\_location | string | Yes |
| priority | integer | No |
| user\_id | integer | Yes |

**Response**

| Field | Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| order\_id | integer |
| status | string |
| created\_at | datetime |

### **2.2 Get Order Details**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | GET |
| Endpoint | `/api/orders/{order_id}` |
| Description | Retrieve order details and current status |

**Response**

| Field | Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| order\_id | integer |
| pickup\_location | string |
| delivery\_location | string |
| status | string |
| assigned\_agent | integer |
| updated\_at | datetime |

### **2.3 Update Order Status (Internal)**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | PUT |
| Endpoint | `/api/orders/{order_id}/status` |
| Description | Update order status based on events |

**Request Body**

| Parameter | Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| status | string |

---

## **3\. Agent Service APIs**

### **3.1 Register Delivery Agent**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `/api/agents` |
| Description | Register a new delivery agent |

**Request Body**

| Parameter | Type | Required |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| name | string | Yes |
| phone | string | Yes |

### **3.2 Update Agent Availability**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | PUT |
| Endpoint | `/api/agents/{agent_id}/availability` |
| Description | Update agent availability status |

**Request Body**

| Parameter | Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| status | string |

### **3.3 Get Agent Details**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | GET |
| Endpoint | `/api/agents/{agent_id}` |
| Description | Fetch agent profile and availability |

## **4\. Scheduler Service APIs (Internal / Optional)**

### **4.1 Trigger Scheduling (Internal)**

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Method | POST |
| Endpoint | `/internal/schedule` |
| Description | Trigger scheduling logic manually |

**Request Body**

| Parameter | Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| order\_id | integer |

## **6\. API Security Considerations**

| Aspect | Approach |
| ----- | ----- |
| Authentication | Token-based |
| Authorization | Role-based |
| Rate Limiting | API Gateway |
| Validation | Request schema validation |

## **7\. API Error Handling (Standard)**

| HTTP Code | Meaning |
| ----- | ----- |
| 200 | Success |
| 201 | Resource Created |
| 400 | Bad Request |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 404 | Resource Not Found |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

| Service | API Type |
| ----- | ----- |
| Order Service | Public |
| Agent Service | Public |
| Scheduler Service | Internal |
